bug_semantics: SQL injection in IOMAD Company Admin Block competency-template management. A company admin with block/iomad_company_admin:managetemplates loads blocks/iomad_company_admin/iomad_templates_form.php, which reads attacker-controlled `search` and `company` via optional_param(..., PARAM_CLEAN) and concatenates them into SQL (`shortname like '%$search%'` and `ccf.companyid=$company`) before $DB->get_records_sql($sql) with no bound parameters. That yields remote CWE-89 (UNION/stacked queries on MariaDB) and matches the reporter's company-admin form to full multi-tenant DB compromise on IOMAD_405_STABLE. The same 2016 introducer added the same LIKE/companyid concatenation in sibling iomad_frameworks_form.php and iomad_competencies_form.php.
flaw_origin: The concatenated LIKE/`companyid=$company` sinks were first written as new Company Admin dashboard pages when company competency templates were added in 2016 (issue #364). They are not a later move or refactor: the parent tree has no iomad_templates_form.php. IOMAD_31_STABLE carries an earlier same-patch object (f425ceade10dc36df7e9790191f15a5465bac587, identical blob and patch-id); the surviving first-write on 3.2+ through the exploited 4.5/5.0 lineages is 3f09d1b3d7f6e329bf4869af0372c33f6f298038. Authorship is human Derick Turner with no commit-object AI marker.

reasoning: CVE-2026-1517 is a real, published SQL injection in Company Admin Block (not withdrawn). First-party vendor comment plus the 2026-01-27 #2442 commit identify the sink as the competency templates/frameworks forms, not a later report-plugin rewrite. The exploitable mechanism is unsanitized concatenation of PARAM_CLEAN `search`/`company` into get_records_sql, requiring company-admin capability, which matches the GHSA issue body. git log -S / --follow and parent-tree checks show those lines were first added as new files in 3f09d1b3d7f6e329bf4869af0372c33f6f298038 (replay of identical 3.1 patch f425ceade10); parent 84f5b65856bebe0e5d38e23d509c521364526597 has no templates form, so this is a true first-write rather than a move/squash. The 2026-01-23 4.5 commit 0c9f8d9ee05d1513162eb0d6b108db85c1796e3a is the smallest supported-branch change that removed concatenation (ancestor of origin/IOMAD_405_STABLE and after IOMAD_405_6); 2026-01-27 e7d51c4a13f2d43380b173df33ed37e0241bdd4e is the direct follow-up that bound the new placeholders.
